taxAdvantage.notes: Henry Ford Health benefits from federal and state income tax exemption, property tax exemption on hospital facilities in Michigan, sales tax exemption, tax-exempt bond interest savings through Michigan Finance Authority, and 340B drug pricing. On $9.6B consolidated revenue, federal income tax exemption alone could represent hundreds of millions in foregone tax.

CVS allegedly terminated pharmacy services agreements in retaliation for audit attempt. Similar lawsuits filed by Mount Sinai, Michigan Medicine, and University of Kansas Health System alleging combined $250M in diversions.

accusation: A tax-exempt nonprofit sitting on $5.0 billion in total assets — including $905 million in publicly traded securities and a $394 million foundation — that reported $9.6 billion in consolidated operating revenue, $294 million in operating income, and $542 million in net income in 2024, while paying its CEO $7.1 million (up from $2.2 million three years prior). Operates Health Alliance Plan as a captive insurance subsidiary with 450,000 members, carries an estimated $1.2 billion in tax-exempt bond debt through the Michigan Finance Authority, claimed $1.6 billion in community benefit, and brands Ford Field as the Detroit Lions' official healthcare partner — a relationship the system has monetized since the 1950s with exclusive stadium signage, head-coach advertising campaigns, and player brand ambassadors.
